title: Tells time, but not a good alarm
text: Tells time, but not a good alarm. Pros are it looks good, the wood finish is classy and the numbers are easy to read and the adjustable brightness is a solid touch. It's a really nice looking piece that ads function and style to a bedroom. HOWEVER, if you need this to wake you up, it might not be the best option. The alarm controls are a little hard to get used to; the buttons on the back aren't immediately intuitive so you need to learn how to shut off the alarm properly. But worse than that... THE ALARM ISN'T LOUD. My son is away for the summer and took this with him as an alarm clock only to find that the alarm is too soft, and there seems to be no way to adjust the volume in the directions. He's using it as a time piece only and will have to rely on his phone to wake him up. A little disappointed about that part.
